caption: The drawing depicts a single garment: a blue cape with a wide, rounded collar that appears to be a separate piece sewn onto the main body of the cape. The cape is mid-length and drapes loosely, flaring outward near the bottom edge. The garment is fastened at the front with two sets of double buttons; each set consists of two buttons joined by a strip of fabric, and all four buttons are round and appear reddish in color. The inner lining of the cape is a pale beige or light tan, visible at the lower front opening and around the neckline. The surface of the cape is uniformly blue with subtle shading to suggest folds and texture, and the background is a plain, unadorned off-white. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Woman's Cape
